description: KnowledgeDrift evaluation benchmark — 50 annotated claim pairs across 4 categories

pairs.claim_a: Employees must submit expense reports within 30 days of incurring the expense.
pairs.claim_b: All expense reports must be submitted within 14 business days.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The company credit card limit is $500 per transaction.
pairs.claim_b: Corporate credit card transactions are limited to $750.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Remote work is permitted for all employees on a permanent basis.
pairs.claim_b: All employees must report to the office at least three days per week.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Annual performance reviews are conducted in December.
pairs.claim_b: Performance evaluations take place annually in Q4.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: The standard probation period is 90 days.
pairs.claim_b: New employees undergo a six-month probationary period.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Health insurance coverage begins on the first day of employment.
pairs.claim_b: Benefits enrollment is effective after the 30-day waiting period.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Employees receive 15 days of paid time off per year.
pairs.claim_b: Annual PTO allocation is 20 days for all full-time staff.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Travel expenses over $200 require manager approval.
pairs.claim_b: Expenses exceeding $200 must be pre-approved by the department head.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: The company observes 10 public holidays annually.
pairs.claim_b: Staff are entitled to 12 paid holidays per calendar year.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Overtime requires written pre-approval from the supervisor.
pairs.claim_b: Overtime work does not require prior authorization.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Data retention policy requires 7 years of record keeping.
pairs.claim_b: Financial records must be maintained for a minimum of seven years.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: Customer data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256.
pairs.claim_b: All sensitive data should be stored in plain text for easy access.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The refund window is 30 days from purchase.
pairs.claim_b: Customers may request refunds within 60 days.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The IT department manages all software licenses.
pairs.claim_b: Individual departments are responsible for procuring their own software.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Quarterly business reviews are mandatory for all departments.
pairs.claim_b: QBR meetings are held every quarter for department leads.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: The server infrastructure uses AWS as the primary cloud provider.
pairs.claim_b: The marketing team uses Canva for design work.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim_a: Password policy requires a minimum of 12 characters.
pairs.claim_b: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Employee referral bonus is $2,000 for successful hires.
pairs.claim_b: The referral program pays $3,500 per qualified referral.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: All meetings should have a written agenda distributed 24 hours in advance.
pairs.claim_b: Meeting agendas must be shared at least one day before the meeting.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: The company uses Slack for internal communication.
pairs.claim_b: Microsoft Teams is the official communication platform.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Code deployments are allowed only on weekdays between 9 AM and 5 PM.
pairs.claim_b: Deployments to production can occur at any time with on-call approval.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The dress code is business casual for all office employees.
pairs.claim_b: Engineering staff may wear casual attire.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim_a: Maternity leave is 12 weeks with full pay.
pairs.claim_b: Parental leave has been extended to 16 weeks effective January 2025.
pairs.label: evolution

pairs.claim_a: The maximum reimbursable hotel rate is $150 per night.
pairs.claim_b: Effective Q2 2025, the nightly hotel cap is $200.
pairs.label: evolution

pairs.claim_a: Annual training budget per employee is $1,500.
pairs.claim_b: Starting 2025, the professional development fund is $2,500 per person.
pairs.label: evolution

pairs.claim_a: Contractors must complete security training within 30 days of onboarding.
pairs.claim_b: Vendor security orientation must be completed before network access is granted.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The company fiscal year runs from January to December.
pairs.claim_b: Our fiscal year begins on April 1st.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: All projects require a risk assessment before kickoff.
pairs.claim_b: Project risk analysis is optional for initiatives under $50K.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Employees are encouraged to participate in volunteer activities.
pairs.claim_b: Staff volunteering programs are available on a quarterly basis.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim_a: Customer support response time SLA is 4 hours.
pairs.claim_b: Support tickets must receive initial response within 2 hours.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The API rate limit is 1000 requests per minute.
pairs.claim_b: API calls are throttled at 500 requests per minute per client.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Board meetings are held quarterly.
pairs.claim_b: The board convenes four times per year.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: Non-disclosure agreements are valid for 2 years after termination.
pairs.claim_b: Confidentiality obligations extend for 5 years post-employment.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Incident response team must be activated within 15 minutes of detection.
pairs.claim_b: Security incidents require team mobilization within one hour.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The new office renovation will include a cafeteria.
pairs.claim_b: Q4 budget allocations include marketing campaign spending.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim_a: Inventory must be counted monthly.
pairs.claim_b: Physical inventory audits occur on a quarterly basis.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The minimum order quantity for wholesale is 100 units.
pairs.claim_b: Wholesale orders require a minimum of 250 units.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Two-factor authentication is required for all admin accounts.
pairs.claim_b: MFA is mandatory for users with elevated privileges.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: The return shipping cost is borne by the customer.
pairs.claim_b: We provide free return shipping on all orders.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Engineering sprints are two weeks long.
pairs.claim_b: Development cycles follow a three-week sprint cadence.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Marketing budget for 2024 is $2.5 million.
pairs.claim_b: The 2025 marketing allocation has been increased to $3.2 million.
pairs.label: evolution

pairs.claim_a: Employees may carry over up to 5 unused PTO days.
pairs.claim_b: Unused paid time off does not carry over to the next year.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The company provides a 401(k) match of 4% of salary.
pairs.claim_b: Effective 2025, the retirement match has been raised to 6%.
pairs.label: evolution

pairs.claim_a: Documentation must follow the Google style guide.
pairs.claim_b: All technical documents should adhere to the company style guide.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim_a: Access to production databases requires VPN connection.
pairs.claim_b: Production systems are accessible only through the corporate network.
pairs.label: entailment

pairs.claim_a: Interns receive a stipend of $25 per hour.
pairs.claim_b: The internship compensation rate is $20 per hour.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Customer escalation requires director-level approval.
pairs.claim_b: Escalated issues may be resolved by any senior manager.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: The data center operates at Tier 3 redundancy.
pairs.claim_b: Our infrastructure is certified as Tier 4 compliant.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: Product roadmap reviews happen bi-weekly.
pairs.claim_b: Roadmap alignment meetings are scheduled monthly.
pairs.label: contradiction

pairs.claim_a: New vendors require a security audit before onboarding.
pairs.claim_b: Third-party suppliers must pass security assessment prior to contract signing.
pairs.label: entailment
